name: Morning Digest Dispatcher
description: At 09:00 AST, deliver quiet-hours outbox items as structured morning digest to Command Center + Discord. Deduplicates, prioritizes, and archives expired items.

payload.message: Run morning digest dispatcher: bash ~/.openclaw/workspace/scripts/morning-digest-dispatcher.sh 2>&1 | tee -a ~/.openclaw/workspace/tracking/digest-dispatch.log
